adjudication.rationale: In `handleCancelBooking.ts`, the diff changes calendar reference handling from a single reference to `filter(...)` and then iterates `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)`. Inside the loop, when `credentialId` is present but not found in `bookingToDelete.user.credentials`, it performs `await prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId } })`. This is one DB query per reference in the worst case, i.e., an N+1 pattern that scales with the number of calendar references (which can grow with host/team count after the destinationCalendar array refactor). This is a performance concern grounded in the diff, not necessarily a functional defect.
